companies.name: シンクロニー・フィナンシャル

relations.text: オンライン預金の勘定系基盤にFiservを使う
relations.text_en: Runs its online deposit core banking platform on Fiserv

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Fiserv provides the core banking platform for our online retail deposits including a customer-facing account opening and servicing platform.

companies.name: ブレッド・ファイナンシャル

relations.text: クレジットカードのプロセシングをFiservに移管(2022年)
relations.text_en: Moved its credit card processing to Fiserv (2022)

source.label: Bread Financial 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: In 2022, we completed the transition of our credit card processing services to Fiserv

companies.name: ユナイテッド・コミュニティ・バンクス

relations.text: Fiserv傘下Cloverと決済の合弁を運営
relations.text_en: Runs a payments joint venture with Fiserv's Clover

source.label: United Community Banks 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We provide payment processing services for our commercial and small business customers through UCPS, which is a joint venture between the Bank and Clover, a merchant services provider and subsidiary of Fiserv, Inc.

companies.name: フルトン・フィナンシャル

relations.text: Fiservとの契約を重要契約として開示
relations.text_en: Discloses its Fiserv agreement as a material contract

source.label: Fulton Financial 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Amendment to Agreement between Fulton Financial Corporation and Fiserv Solutions, LLC dated December 20, 2021.

companies.name: プライオリティ・テクノロジー

relations.text: 加盟店の取引処理でFiservなどと処理契約を結ぶ
relations.text_en: Uses processors such as Fiserv for merchant transaction processing

source.label: Priority Technology 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we serve as a merchant acquirer and enter into processing agreements with payment processors, such as Fiserv or Global Payments

companies.name: ファースト・ソーラー

relations.text: First Solarの税額控除6.872億ドル分をFiservが購入(2023年12月)
relations.text_en: Bought $687.2 million of First Solar's tax credits (December 2023)

source.label: First Solar 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: In December 2023, we entered into two agreements with Fiserv for the sale of $687.2 million of Section 45X tax credits we generated during 2023

relations.text: ATM運営の委託先の一社としてFiservを挙げる
relations.text_en: Lists Fiserv among its operations vendors

source.label: Bitcoin Depot 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Operations vendors include, but are not limited to, Bibbeo, Burroughs, Cennox, DropPin, Fiserv, National Services, and OptConnect.

companies.name: グローバル・ペイメンツ

relations.text: Global Paymentsが10-Kで、米国の競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Global Payments names Fiserv first among US competitors

source.label: Global Payments 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: In the United States, we compete with a large number of providers, including but not limited to Fiserv, Inc.

relations.text: Shift4が10-Kで、決済処理の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Shift4 names Fiserv among payment processing competitors

source.label: Shift4 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we compete with non-integrated payment processors (such as Chase Paymentech, Elavon, Worldpay, Fiserv and Global Payments)

relations.text: ACIが10-Kで、決済処理の主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: ACI names Fiserv among primary payment processing competitors

source.label: ACI Worldwide 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Primary digital payment processing competitors in this area include global entities such as Atos Origin S.A., Fiserv, Mastercard, SiNSYS, and Visa

relations.text: Q2が10-Kで、勘定系の競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Q2 lists Fiserv first among core processing competitors

source.label: Q2 Holdings 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We also compete with core processing vendors that provide systems and services such as Fiserv, Jack Henry and Associates and Fidelity National Information Services, or FIS.

relations.text: NCR Atleosが10-Kで、ATM分野の競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: NCR Atleos lists Fiserv first among ATM competitors

source.label: NCR Atleos 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our competition consists of global ATM software, services and hardware companies including Fiserv, Euronet, Brink's Company, Hyosung, and Diebold Nixdorf.

relations.text: Marqetaが10-Kで、従来型の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Marqeta names Fiserv among legacy platform competitors

source.label: Marqeta 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: such as Fidelity National Information Services (FIS), Fiserv, and Global Payments (TSYS)
